subject: Phased implementation plan for marketplace pass-through (MSA + Order Form)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cloudway.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Cloudway Procurement <procurement@cloudway.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@cloudway.com>
Date: 2027-11-14 09:12 PST
Subject: Marketplace addendum redline + ask on pass-through invoicing

Marcus —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attaching our proposed redline to the MSA and a clean Order Form that reflects the marketplace fee pass-through and settlement timing we need to align on. High level asks from Cloudway:

- Confirm that Redwood will accept pass-through of marketplace fees with a 30-day settlement window to the reseller (Cloudway).
- Preserve mutual indemnity carveouts for third-party marketplace charges (see Sec. 7.4 in our redline).
- Provide an audit contact and sample invoice flow so our billing team can reconcile monthly.

We'd like to execute a phased approach:
1) Immediate adoption of the pass-through language on a trial basis for Q4 (billing only; no audit rights exercised during trial).
2) Full addendum execution (including audit and indemnity language) thereafter if trial metrics look good.

Attaching: MSA_redline_v3.docx, OrderForm_pass-through_clean.pdf, and an implementation timeline spreadsheet.

Can your legal and revenue ops teams review and confirm if Redwood can accept the phased approach and the specific Sec. 7.4 carveout? If we can get signoff by next Wednesday (11/17) we can get the trial invoicing live for 11/30 statements.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Partner Contracts | Cloudway Solutions
maya.patel@cloudway.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Date: 2027-11-14 11:05 PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum redline + ask on pass-through invoicing

Maya —

Appreciate the clear summary and the redlines. Looping in Ben (Legal ops / partner contracts) and Kim (Revenue Ops) to confirm feasibility. Quick thoughts from Redwood:

- We can accept a phased billing trial for Q4, provided we agree to simple guardrails (30-day window, sample invoices delivered to procurement@cloudway.com, and a single reconciliation run per month).
- Regarding Sec. 7.4 (indemnity carveouts): our Legal would prefer language that limits the carveout to "direct marketplace transaction fees" and excludes any marketplace-driven chargebacks or fines that result from misuse. Ben — can you propose concise replacement language?
- Audit rights: we can delay full audit exercise during the trial as suggested, but need a commitment to a post-trial audit window (45 days) if either party requests it.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to draft a narrow alternate for Sec. 7.4 and circulate redline by EOD Monday (11/15).
- Kim to confirm the billing path and sample invoice fields we need (PO number, settlement ID, marketplace fee line).
- Set a 30-minute working session Tuesday 11/16 at 10:00 PT to align on language and rollout checklist.

If that works for Cloudway, we'll aim to circulate an agreed clean Order Form for signature by 11/18.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0212

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@cloudway.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-15 09:47 PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum redline + ask on pass-through invoicing

Marcus / Maya —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the Cloudway Sec. 7.4 redline and suggest the following compromise language that keeps the carveout narrow while protecting Redwood from downstream marketplace liabilities: 

Suggested language (replace Sec. 7.4 carveout):
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Marketplace Transaction Fees paid by Customer to Marketplace Resellers shall be treated as pass-through fees for settlement purposes. Redwood shall not be liable for third-party marketplace penalties arising from Customer misuse, fraud, or violations of Marketplace terms. Customer retains the right to audit billing records relating to Marketplace Transaction Fees following the trial period with 45 days' notice."

Rationale: this preserves the pass-through settlement behavior Cloudway needs, closes the open-ended exposure to penalties, and provides a clear timeline for audits.

On implementation specifics: Kim and I recommend including three invoice fields as minimum for settlement: PO, Settlement ID, and Marketplace Fee line (gross and net). I'll add those as a sample CSV in the implementation_timeline.xlsx.

If this language looks acceptable, I'll insert it into the MSA redline and send back a tracked copy by EOD.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks all — quick operational confirmation from Revenue Ops:

- We can support the 30-day trial billing cadence. Need Cloudway to send a sample invoice (one month-end) to procurement@cloudway.com and to revenue-ops@redwood.com by 11/22 so we can validate fields.
- Required minimum invoice fields: Invoice Date, PO Number, Settlement ID, Marketplace Fee (gross), Marketplace Fee (net), Currency, and Billing Contact.
- For the trial period we will not open audits, but we will enable a reconciliation report shared via the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyzDocLink).

Action items / owners:
- Maya / Cloudway: confirm if sample invoice can be provided by 11/22 and whether Cloudway requires a specific remittance address/flow.
- Ben: include suggested Sec. 7.4 language into the redline and resend doc for final quick review (target: 11/17 EOD).
- Marcus: coordinate signature timeline once the clean Order Form is agreed (target signature by 11/18 if redline closes).

If no objections from Cloudway, I'll prepare a short Ops runbook for the trial and route to both teams.

Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
